main_body: A flat ground patch (farm field): golden crop/straw rows on top, a green grass band, and brown tilled soil rows with sprouts below. It is a terrain tile block, not a standing object.
top_band: none - terrain ground tiles, no standing body; golden straw/crop texture rows 0-14 are ground surface
evidence: The candidate is a ground/terrain autotile patch made of horizontal bands of crop, grass and tilled soil. It is not a standing object, so the top-plus-front contract does not apply. Terrain is a valid kind and no receding side faces are drawn. The patch has some pseudo-vertical layering (grass edge over soil) but reads as ground.

style.evidence: The candidate has a lot of per-pixel variation: the golden crop area uses yellow, cream, olive and brown dithering, the grass tufts use 4-5 greens, and the soil uses several browns with lighter clods and sprouts. Dark edges next to the soil are dark brown and next to the grass dark green, so they are tinted by material rather than neutral black. There are no large flat fills. Density is at least equal to the Beodeul grass and paving references, which are comparatively sparse.
